findings.desc: Progressive intent hardening over-warns for the documented small typo example: the regex treats 'fix' as behaviorChange and 'complete' as scope ambiguity, so 'Complete this small typo fix' becomes standard with missing intent collision/red evidence/scope gaps even though the requirements doc calls it a single-outcome Intent MVP task. This is diagnostic-only today, but it will create false positives before warn/enforce rollout.
